name: Microwave Stuffed Potato
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes (about 300 g total), scrubbed and pricked
½ cup cooked chickpeas, lightly mashed
1 small onion and 1 tomato, finely chopped
½ tsp each cumin, chaat masala and chilli powder
steps: Microwave the potatoes on high for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway, until tender. Rest for 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, microwave the oil, onion and tomato covered for 3 minutes. Stir in the chickpeas, tofu, spices and salt; microwave 2 minutes.
Split the potatoes and fluff the insides with a fork.
Finish with coriander and lemon juice.
note: Eating the skin adds fibre; the chickpea and tofu filling brings the protein up.
